name: Laboratory DC Bench Ammeter (0-3A)
semanticDescription: Laboratory-grade DC moving-coil ammeter (0 to 3 A scale with bold A emblem) for measuring electric current in series circuits (NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 11 Electricity and Class 12 Physics Chapter 4). Features dual presentation collections: Ammeter_Full (complete bench instrument in molded black Bakelite casing, front glass window, crimson needle indicating 1.4 A, mechanical zero-adjustment screw, top knurled brass binding posts on studio slate plinth) and Ammeter_Section (cutaway revealing internal electromechanical movement: moving coil galvanometer assembly, low-resistance manganin shunt resistor strip S in parallel across the coil, copper busbars routing total current I = Ig + Is, and educational plaque on brass stanchions).
simplifications: Shunt resistor represented as calibrated manganin metal strip with clamping blocks.
Internal copper leads routed cleanly for pedagogical clarity.

materials.look: Molded black phenolic Bakelite instrument casing
Crisp white matte printed scale face with 0-3A graduations and bold A
Crimson red lightweight aluminum indicator pointer
Concave cylindrical North (red) and South (blue) permanent magnet pole shoes
Dark studio slate display pedestal with satin gold trim
